subject: Lobby Floor Tile Pattern Clarification
question:
Drawing A-110 (Main Lobby Floor Plan) shows a diagonal tile pattern in the elevator lobby area, but the finish schedule (Drawing A-901) specifies a running bond pattern for the same tile (Porcelanosa Bottega Caliza 24x48).

Please confirm which pattern is correct for the elevator lobby area (approximately 800 SF).

response.text:
The diagonal pattern shown on A-110 is correct for the elevator lobby area. The finish schedule (A-901) has been updated to reflect this. The running bond pattern applies only to the corridor areas outside the elevator lobby.

Revised finish schedule issued with ASI-011.

schedule_impact: None - tile installation not yet started
